productLoss: Panel, search, result, section, row, footer, query, and result geometry are exact, but the light Lynx panel uses opaque rgb(252,252,252), 12px radii, and a 90% black shadow while Web uses 80% white glass, 18px radii, and a 65% black shadow.
The Lynx footer's middle hint says Command-P Files while the Web command-mode authority says Enter Select.
The clean footer crop measures 12.866499 MAE and 16.4269% significant pixels.
harnessMismatch: Three initial attempts routed Quick Switch Query through the default SB2 fixture because the state was missing from the thread-state registry. The selected-project identity precondition therefore prevented Web input while Lynx opened; those one-sided frames are invalid.
Quick Switch default/query/actions-only/empty now use the same copied thread fixture as the existing chat, Files, and model-picker states. A dark control passes before this light baseline.
The Web full-frame and panel crops include an external provider-update notification. They remain diagnostic only and are excluded from material attribution; the footer crop is unobscured.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Web uses backdrop-filter blur and Base UI dialog compositing. Lynx uses Native-safe alpha, border, inset highlight, and shadow equivalents without claiming blur parity.
classification.evidenceBoundary: One immutable snapshot, selected project and thread, light theme, 1280x820 viewport, shipping Web and Lynx-for-Web bundles, real Meta-K input packets, query text input, one matching result, exact geometry, zero console errors, and zero owned or orphaned agent-browser processes. Native remains unobserved at baseline.

excluded.reason: External provider-update notification overlaps the Web panel.
